remarks: Welcome to this bright and spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo in a prime Stamford location, offering both comfort and convenience. The unit features an expansive living and dining area, enhanced by hardwood floors and high ceilings that create an open, airy feel with abundant natural light. The kitchen and bathroom have been tastefully updated for modern living. Located on the first floor, this home provides easy access and everyday practicality. The well-maintained complex includes multiple laundry facilities and beautifully landscaped courtyards, ideal for relaxing outdoors. Heat and hot water are included in the rent, adding extra value. The unit also comes with one assigned parking space, along with ample visitor parking. Perfectly situated near public transportation, schools, shopping, dining, and everything Stamford has to offer. It is an ideal place to call home.
